cardTableCards.title: XVII · The Star
cardTableCards.body:
Hope and Spiritual Inspiration
Stun two targets for two turns, gain permanent +1 to charisma
"Often, when we guess at others' motives, we reveal only our own"

cardTableCards.title: I · The Magician
cardTableCards.body:
Manifestation and Resourcefulness
Restore resources and spells, add  +1 to all resources permanently
"Do you fear death? Do you fear that dark abyss"

cardTableCards.title: X · Wheel of Fortune
cardTableCards.body:
Turning Points and Good luck
Cannot roll below 15 for the next 2 turns, permanent +1 to rolls
"Fortune favors me, and me alone"

cardTableCards.title: XVIII · The Moon
cardTableCards.body:
Illusion and Hidden Truth
Cannot get hit by attacks for the next two turns, enemies have -1 accuracy against you permanently, and gain 5ft of movement
"I don't know about angels, but it's fear that gives men wings."

cardTableCards.title: XII · The Hanged Man
cardTableCards.body:
Surrender and New Perspective

gain permanent +1 to perception 
"My soul was burned once, now I see the world for what it is"

cardTableCards.title: XIV · Temperance
cardTableCards.body:
Balance and Patience
Gain 25% health and armor for the next two turns, gain permanent +1 to constitution and dexterity
"War educates the senses, calls into action the will, perfects the physical constitution"

cardTableCards.title: IX · The Hermit
cardTableCards.body:
Solitude and Inner guidance
Gain 25% armor gain 15ft movement for the next two turns, gain permanent +1 to wisdom
"Whom shall I send? And who will go for us. I will"

cardTableCards.title: IV · The Emperor
cardTableCards.body:
Authority and Structure
Cancel attacks from two targets, gain permanent+1 to strength
"Had to be me. Someone else might have gotten it wrong"

cardTableCards.title: XX · Judgement
cardTableCards.body:
Awakening and Rebirth
Revive on death, gain a permanent action point on death
"I survived because the fire inside burned brighter than the fire around me"

cardTableCards.title: XXI · The World
cardTableCards.body:
Completion and Wholeness
Gain 100% armor for the next two turns,  gain permanent 15% armor
"In a world without gold, we might have been hero's"

cardTableCards.title: VI · The Lovers
cardTableCards.body:
Love and Harmony
Untargetable for two turns
Add permanent 1 to charisma and constitution
"I have no enemies"

cardTableCards.title: III · The Empress
cardTableCards.body:
Abundance and Creativity
Guns are infinite for the next two turns, +3 accuracy for the next two turns.
Add permanent 1 to intelligence
"I will carry out great vengeance on them and punish them in my wrath"

cardTableCards.title: V · The Hierophant
cardTableCards.body:
Tradition and Conformity
Gain an immediate action, disable all spells for two turns
Add permanent 1 to wisdom and dexterity
"We all make choices, but in the end, our choices make us"

cardTableCards.title: XV · The Devil
cardTableCards.body:
Materialism and Self Restriction
Ammo refilled, weapons reloaded, gain permanent +2 to damage
"You exist because we allow it, and you will end because we demand it"

cardTableCards.title: XIX · The Sun
cardTableCards.body:
Joy and Vitality
Full heal, stamina regained, gain 15% permanent health
"Hesitation is defeat"

cardTableCards.title: XVI · The Tower
cardTableCards.body:
Sudden Upheaval and Revelation
Ignore armor for the next two turns, gain permanent +1 accuracy
"I see through you now, you are nothing"

cardTableCards.title: XI · Justice
cardTableCards.body:
Fairness and Truth
Gain immediate action, +3 to damage and accuracy
gain permanent +1 to damage, and accuracy
"I have reached my verdict, and I sentence you to death"

cardTableCards.title: XIII · Death
cardTableCards.body:
Transformation and Major Endings
Revive on death, gain a level.
"When death itself is dead I shall be alive."

cardTableCards.title: VII · The Chariot
cardTableCards.body:
Willpower and Determination
Max damage on rolls for the next two turns, gain permanent +2 to damage 
"What is better: to be born good or to overcome your evil nature through great effort"

cardTableCards.title: VIII · Strength
cardTableCards.body:
Courage and Resilience
Gain 50% armor and health for the next two turns.
Add permanent 1 to Strength
"Struggle, endure, contend"

cardTableCards.title: II · The High Priestess
cardTableCards.body:
Intuition and Knowledge
Cannot miss attacks for the next two turns, gain permanent +1 to accuracy
"The Lord is my rock, my fortress, my deliverer, and to him I shall deliver you"
